resources.string: Back up the whole Ubuntu or chosen folders to any folder of the phone (Premium), checked before it counts. Restore is for everyone. In Quick Launch, Backup on an Ubuntu card.
Open Ubuntu in this tab or a new one
Choose each time, or remember it in Settings → Terminal → Ubuntu launch behavior.
File Manager on all of your storage
With All files access the File Manager shows the whole internal storage, not only TermiNow Home.
Ubuntu and Claude Code no longer stop taking keys after a while, and a busy terminal no longer makes TermiNow hang.
If a tab still seems stuck: Terminal diagnostics, and a debug log you can save and send. It never holds what a tab shows or what you type.
Swipe left or right on the terminal for the next or previous session.
Install in the toolbar now has Cursor CLI, gstack and the Claude Code plugins of the official marketplace.
